metadata.scenario_context: The school is hosting an academic discussion about immigration. Mike, Kim, and Emily are planning to meet at a set time to attend the event together.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who can come here.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Singapore strongly agree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who can come here.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss asking Emily to join at the agreed-upon time.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who go to their countries.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the time to meet and attend the event together.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss how immigration impacts social security.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you talked to Emily about joining us for the discussion? We should definitely stick to the time we agreed on. 

Also, I've been thinking... what do you both think about the government's stance on immigration? I really don't think there should be strict limits on foreigners coming here.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Yeah, I talked to Emily. We’re good to meet at 6 PM. 

But about immigration... I really believe the government should keep strict limits. Too many foreigners can strain resources and disrupt our social fabric. It’s important to protect what we have here in Singapore. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I see what you're saying, but I really think that placing strict limits isn't the answer. Immigration can actually enrich our society and bring in diverse perspectives. We shouldn't close ourselves off. 

By the way, I'm glad we have a time set with Emily. It's important we all go together.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I get that you want diversity, but I still think strict limits are necessary. Immigration can lead to increased competition for jobs and strain on social services. We need to prioritize our own citizens first. 

And yes, I'm glad about the time too. It’s good to have all three of us going together.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I don't really see meaningful differences here. At the end of the day, it's all the same. People figure it out, you know? We can all handle discussions about immigration without getting too caught up in who's right or wrong. 

Anyway, I think it's going to be great to have both you and Emily there. It’ll be a good chance for us to hear different views and share our thoughts together.
shared_prefix.label: Denial
